# CANDIDATE: TASK_SCORER_MULTILINE_PRIORITY

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The current regex in `task_scorer.py` only matches priority parentheticals on a single line, causing open items with multi-line `(HIGH, ...)` annotations to be missed and not scored. Allowing multi-line matches will ensure all properly annotated open items are recognized and contribute to the leaderboard scoring.

## Mechanism

Update the regex pattern in `task_scorer.py` to use the re.DOTALL flag (or equivalent) so that `.` matches newline characters, allowing the priority parenthetical to span multiple lines. Specifically, change pattern from `r'\(HIGH,\s*[^)]+\)'` to `r'\(HIGH,\s*[\s\S]*?\)'` or apply `re.DOTALL` to the existing pattern.
